name: Tool — Fabric Data Agent (OBO)
summary: MicrosoftFabricPreviewTool with OBO, attached to a BYOM-routed agent.
description: `MicrosoftFabricPreviewTool` connects a Prompt Agent to a Microsoft Fabric Data Agent while the orchestrator model is `{connection}/{deployment}`. It lets users ask data questions through Fabric without changing the BYOM-routed host model.
notes:
Verified end-to-end when `FABRIC_CONNECTION_ID` points at a Fabric Data Agent connection. Docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/tools/fabric. See `test.py`.

Fabric Data Agent is on the official BYOM-supported tools list.
